about.title: Balance between two worlds.
about.paragraph_1: Hi! I'm Pedro de Freitas, a professional in career transition to Conversational UX Designer and AI Engineer. My path begins with listening, understanding how people say what they need, and matures in building: translating that listening into flows, prompts and systems that respond with clarity.
about.paragraph_2: With a background in Social Communication, Graphic Design and Operations Management with international clients, I have a distinct perspective on how to address each type of need. Whether technological or human.
about.paragraph_3: Almost a decade of 1:1 work with people around the world gave me a singular perspective: understanding what someone truly needs, a skill that translates directly into designing clear, empathetic and efficient conversations.
